final: WITH g AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(feecoin),'') AS c, AVG(rebtotal) AS ar, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate <> 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) AS ag FROM fees GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(feecoin),'')), b AS (SELECT AVG(ar) AS bench FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.ar) AS mean_avg_rebate, AVG(g.ag) AS mean_avg_rel_gap, AVG(g.ar - b.bench) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM g, b WHERE g.ar > b.bench
